\vspace{4pt}
\noindent\textit{Note:} Node2Vec+KM is invariant to feature setting by construction (uses topology-only random walks). Negative modularity values on GRN reflect degenerate partitions produced by some architectures on this large, sparse regulatory network. The real-vs-random feature benefit is +93\% on SIGNOR, +56\% on GRN, +100\% on BioGRID, and +56\% on GTEx. GTEx shows minimal absolute benefit due to extreme density (avg.\ degree ${\approx}500$) where topology dominates.
